title: No Road Home
description: A 3D survival starter built from a small scenario file. Scavenge four buildings, craft useful tools, manage pack space, distract noise-aware visitors, repair the emergency radio and reach the south road. Doors and loot persist; portable save codes restore the run. WASD moves, Shift runs, C creeps, E interacts, Space swings, I opens crafting/save, F heals, Q throws a decoy, B braces a door. The simulation runs locally without model calls or a game server.
author: the internet slop warehouse
